dedupe_keys.name: finnish building stock default structural and ventilation data

description: VTT’s Finnish building-stock default dataset describes construction layers and thermal properties used to represent Finnish buildings. Topi Rasku assembled it for the FlexiB research project from Finnish energy-certificate guidance, building codes and other public references. CSV tables describe wall, roof and floor layers, material density, heat capacity, conductivity, window properties, ventilation and infiltration. Coverage is Finland, organised by source period, building type and construction, not individual mapped buildings. Historical construction eras are represented through source-year categories; no regular measurement interval or live update schedule is stated. GitHub provides the CSV files, a Frictionless Data Package definition and a Spine Toolbox importer specification, all free under CC BY 4.0. A material limitation is that construction prevalence weights and some missing physical values are estimates, not measured stock statistics. Users should inspect those assumptions before calibrating heat demand. Simulation uses include thermal archetype preparation and building-stock energy scenarios. The dataset complements data-hotmaps-building-stock-and-heat-density-maps and model-teaser-building-archetype-modelica, without a demonstrated direct conversion to either.
